cases.name: pattern-signal
cases.description: A single line is a trajectory and takes no draws
cases.config: <tdc><env count="8" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="pattern" points="0,0 5,100 10,0" y_range="0..10" decimals="2"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: pattern-smooth
cases.description: smooth eases through the points without overshooting them
cases.config: <tdc><env count="8" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="pattern" points="0,0 5,100 10,0" y_range="0..10" decimals="2" interp="smooth"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: pattern-step
cases.description: step holds each value until the next point
cases.config: <tdc><env count="8" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="pattern" points="0,0 5,100 10,0" y_range="0..10" decimals="2" interp="step"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: pattern-y-range
cases.description: y_range maps the drawing's height into real values
cases.config: <tdc><env count="8" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="pattern" points="0,0 5,100 10,0" y_range="100..200" decimals="1"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: pattern-spread
cases.description: spread scatters a single line into a tunnel
cases.config: <tdc><env count="8" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="pattern" points="0,0 5,100 10,0" y_range="0..10" decimals="2" spread="1"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: pattern-corridor
cases.description: A corridor picks a value between two lines
cases.config: <tdc><env count="8" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="pattern" upper="0,100 10,100" lower="0,0 10,0" y_range="0..100" decimals="1"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: pattern-density
cases.description: mode=density reads the same drawing as a distribution
cases.config: <tdc><env count="8" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="pattern" points="0,0 5,100 10,0" y_range="0..100" decimals="1" mode="density"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: pattern-reads-the-crossing
cases.description: A drawing with more detail than the run has cards. Each card reads where its own position crosses the line — never an average of the slice around it, which used to make neighbouring cards obey different rules.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="pattern" points="0,0 1,50 2,10 3,90 4,0" y_range="0..10" decimals="3"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: pattern-flat-line-is-the-middle
cases.description: A single line is a trajectory and takes no draws
cases.config: <tdc><env count="8" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="pattern" points="0,50 10,50" y_range="-5..5" decimals="1"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: pattern-flat-line-scales-up
cases.description: A single line is a trajectory and takes no draws
cases.config: <tdc><env count="8" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="pattern" points="0,50 10,50" y_range="0..200" decimals="1"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>
